label: Surawatsatien 2026
setting: ophthalmology clinic at a tertiary hospital (King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital)
diagnosis_mix: NR (retinal diseases most common concurrent ocular disease; baseline table in Appendix 1, not in text); better-eye vision impairment: none 245, mild 15, moderate 28, severe 1, blindness 12
recruitment: convenience sample, Feb 1-Mar 31 2024; 421 approached, 120 declined (refusal 28.5%), 301 interviewed at baseline; 275 completed 2-week follow-up
instruments: EQ-5D-3L; EQ-5D-5L; EQ-VAS; Vision bolt-on EQ-5D-3L; Vision bolt-on EQ-5D-5L
notes: Not an accuracy study: no sens/spec/AUC; psychometrics (test-retest ICC/kappa, known-groups, convergent Spearman, responsiveness) of vision bolt-on EQ-5D. n_items=1 is the added vision item. pct_female = 178/301 (Table 4 p7). Age/sex baseline table is in Appendix 1 (not in text); age groups in Table 4 p7. ~46% self-completed, rest read aloud by interviewer (p5). BCVA better-eye ICD-11 categories (p4). Bolt-on time 18-24 s (p10, Table 1 p6). Test-retest n=275 completers, but n in the ICC analysis (no-change group) NR; responsiveness better N=121, worse N=24 (Table 6 p9).
